name: Rabid cuts every Howl cooldown by 25% (#2823)
contract: Rabid 705732 is one effect: aura 108 with MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), BasePoints -26 + DieSides 1 = -25%, over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 133248) = word 2 bits 17, 11 and 7. Those bits select every family-26 record named "Howl": Blood Howl 800782 and Monstrous Howl 804811 (bit 17), Night Hunter's Howl 500124/501680-501686 (bit 11), Shadow Howl 806177 and Wicked Howl 804207 (bit 7). Player::ApplySpellMod consumes SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN in the cooldown path. Tooltip: "Reduces the cooldown of Howl spells by $s1%." Regression guard for native behaviour.
